title: The Observer (U.S. MACV Information Office), Saigon, 24 July 1965
citation: "Wounded Sergeant Blasts Bu Dop Invaders, Camp Littered With Dead VC," The Observer, published weekly for the U.S. Forces in Vietnam, Information Office, U.S. Military Assistance Command Vietnam, Saigon, vol. IV, no. 12, 24 July 1965, p. 1. Helen Roller Collection, Vietnam Center and Sam Johnson Vietnam Archive, Texas Tech University, item 1521Newspaper249812.
notes: MACV's own weekly paper, reporting the Viet Cong attack on the Bu Dop Special Forces camp shortly after 1 a.m. on 20 July 1965. Quotes the camp's communications sergeant, SSgt. Michael F. Carpenter: 'I contacted the Black Virgin Mountain radio station and shouted, We're being hit! We're being hit!' The first documentary evidence found that a radio station was operating on Nui Ba Den in 1965 and that Special Forces camps in III Corps called it when they were attacked.
